description: sdd-requirements-engineer Mode 2 pre-pass: one item per requirement, state = {requirement: <statement>}. Validated on seeded defects (examples/todo-app + mutants): 0 false positives on clean EARS statements.

vague.instructions: Does `requirement` use a vague or unmeasurable term (like fast, quickly, user-friendly, appropriate, efficient, intuitive, many, where possible) whose pass/fail meaning is not defined in the text?

compound.instructions: Does `requirement` bundle two or more independent behaviors that could be implemented, tested or changed separately (not just several fields of the same result)?

criteria.true: Two or more separable behaviors, e.g. create a task AND send an email
criteria.false: One behavior, even if its result has several attributes

unverifiable.instructions: Would a tester be unable to write an objective pass/fail test for `requirement` as written, because it describes a feeling, opinion or quality with no observable outcome?

impl_leak.instructions: Does `requirement` prescribe how to build it (specific database tables, libraries, classes, functions or UI frameworks) instead of the observable behavior the user needs?

criteria.ubiquitous: THE <system> SHALL <response>, with no trigger or condition
criteria.unwanted: Starts with IF <unwanted condition> THEN THE <system> SHALL
criteria.optional: Starts with WHERE <feature or setting is present> THE <system> SHALL
criteria.not_ears: Does not use the EARS keywords (THE ... SHALL with WHEN/WHILE/IF/WHERE or none); plain prose, 'should', 'can', 'must'
